title: Access VLAN Fundamentals
summary: Create a user VLAN and place an edge port into it.
brief: The users connected to Ethernet1 belong in VLAN 20. Build the VLAN, give it a useful name, configure the port as an enabled access port, and verify your work.
objectives: Create VLAN 20 and name it USERS
Configure Ethernet1 as an access port in VLAN 20
Verify the result with EOS show commands
hints: Use enable and configure terminal to reach global configuration mode.
VLAN names are configured from VLAN configuration mode.
An access VLAN and switchport mode are separate interface commands.
show vlan and show interfaces Ethernet1 switchport are useful verification commands.
